new_election <- polls_us_election_2016

new_election[] <- lapply(new_election, function(x) {
  
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    
    x[is.na(x)] <- my_birth_year + k
    
  } else if (is.character(x)){
  
    x[is.na(x)] <- paste0(my_first, "_", k)
    
  } else if (is.factor(x)){ 
  
   new_val <- paste0(my_first, "_", k)
   levels(x) <- c(levels(x), new_val)
   x[is.na(x)] <- new_val
    
  }
  return(x) 
  
 #  yeni level eklediğimizde neden return gerekli? 
})
